study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TractoInferno: 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from 6 sites, used for pretraining. NIMHANS: 302 participants (123 CN, 89 MCI, 90 AD) from 2 scanners (Philips Ingenia and Siemens Skyra) in India, used for fine-tuning and inference.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset [32], acquired on 3T scanners from 6 sites. ... We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences) cohort (see Table I) in India.
